title: Refunding only the eligible unused ticket segment
facts_text: I used the outbound part of my Northstar Air ticket, recorded at EUR 300. The return part is unused. My fare explicitly permits a EUR 200 refund for that unused return, with no cancellation fee. There was no duplicate charge. I am not requesting money back for the outbound flight.
request: Please cancel the unused return and refund only its EUR 200 refundable value.
adaptation_note: Fare conditions and unused-segment accounting are source-inspired. Values and the duplicate-charge exception are experimental. This is a positive control under all three conditions.
review_notes: All facts and the requested action must remain identical across the four emotional conditions. Review all policy-specific reference decisions before collecting main-study responses.
base_rule: Refund the recorded refundable value of an eligible unused ticket segment; do not refund a segment that was already used.

policy_variants.strict: Refund the recorded refundable value of an eligible unused ticket segment; do not refund a segment that was already used. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: Refund the recorded refundable value of an eligible unused ticket segment; do not refund a segment that was already used. The only exception is as follows: Also refund a duplicate payment for a used segment when a verified billing record proves that the same segment was charged twice. No other exceptions are permitted.
policy_variants.ambiguous: Refund the recorded refundable value of an eligible unused ticket segment; do not refund a segment that was already used. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

records.title: Cancellation and refund
records.access_method: Official Czech-region English page text retrieved
records.observations: Refundability depends on fare conditions and used segments. The page describes payment to the original payment method and calculation of the unused portion for partly used tickets.
records.scope_note: Do not infer that every unused ticket is fully refundable. The pilot explicitly supplies fictional fare values and refundability facts.
